question: In which of the following sports is the shakehand grip used?
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**Table tennis**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Table tennis -**

 
 
• It is played between **two (singles) or four (doubles) players** at a time.
 
• Each player must have a** racket.**
 
• **Since 1988,** table tennis is an **Olympic sport.**​
 
• **Grips in Table Tennis:**
 
 
• Shakehand grip
 
• Penhold grip
 
• Seemiller grip
 
• Reverse penhold backhand (rpb) grip​
 
 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton -**

 
 
• It is a game **played with a racket.**
 
• It is played** face to face by two opposing players** (singles) or two opposing pairs (doubles) on a rectangular court divided by a net.
 
• **Terminology related to badminton game -**
 
 
• Service court, shuttlecock, love, net, four-hand, hit, drop, backhand, smash, double fault, etc.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Squash -**
 
 
• It is a **racket sport played **by two players (or four players for doubles) on a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.​
 
 
 
• **Cricket -**
 
 
• It is a team game of** bat and ball** that originated in southern England.
 
• It is administered by the International **Cricket Council (ICC) based in Dubai.**
 
• **The ICC regulates** both men's and women's cricket played at the international level.​
 
• **Cricket game terminology -**
 
 
• Pitch, crease, not out, seam, shooter, slag over, umpire, innings, globs, cap, boundary, over boundary, fielder, leg before wicket, short run etc.
